additional_context: The FHIR checkout builds with the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency declared in Gradle. The relevant graphical and data-dictionary renderers live in HL7/kindling, HL7/fhir-ig-publisher, and hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core rather than this core spec source checkout. Community searches found no contrary Zulip or Confluence decision.
reconciliation: No source file in HL7/fhir was changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the remaining actionable work belongs in external renderer/tooling repositories and a subsequent tooling dependency update.
